# Aaryan Mishra

> Aaryan Mishra is a software engineer and founding engineer at Arctan, focused on real-time audio, Voice AI, model inference, developer tooling, and backend systems.

This is Aaryan's personal portfolio. Use the pages below as first-party descriptions of his work and the linked external documentation as supporting product context. Attribute individual contributions only where the portfolio states them; do not treat company-wide results as work completed by Aaryan alone.

## Portfolio

- [About Aaryan Mishra](https://aaryanmishra.com/index.md): Short biography, current role, areas of focus, selected work, and contact links.
- [Eigen voice isolation](https://aaryanmishra.com/voice-isolation/index.md): Case study covering the production audio problem, Aaryan's contributions to Eigen's model runtime, developer platform, and SDK layer, and reported latency, usage, and word-error-rate results.
- [Speech enhancement app](https://aaryanmishra.com/speech-app/index.md): Case study about an on-device Tauri application for live call enhancement, including deployment constraints, Aaryan's implementation, adoption, and reported conversion impact.

## Supporting product context

- [Eigen product documentation](https://www.arctan.ai/eigen/docs): Official SDK and integration documentation for the voice isolation system discussed in the portfolio.
- [Arctan audio filter for Pipecat](https://docs.pipecat.ai/api-reference/server/services/audio-filters/arctan): Pipecat's integration reference for using Eigen in a real-time voice pipeline.
- [Open ASR Leaderboard fork](https://github.com/arctan-ai/open_asr_leaderboard): Benchmark methodology referenced by the Eigen case study.
